description: GitHub Integration UI: OAuth connection flow, repository listing, and import modal with real-time progress. Creates GithubIntegrationPage (connection status, OAuth popup, repo grid), GithubCallbackPage (OAuth callback handler with postMessage), RepositoryImportModal (project selector, progress bar polling at 2s intervals). Depends on FEAT-001 types, services, and components.
steps: 1. Create src/components/github/RepositoryImportModal.tsx: modal (fixed overlay z-index 999, card z-index 1000) with project selector dropdown, Import button, real-time progress bar. On import start, polls getImportStatus every 2s until status is COMPLETED or FAILED. Shows ProgressBar with progressPercentage from status. Success shows CheckCircle icon with 'Import complete'. Error shows XCircle with error message. useEffect cleanup cancels interval on unmount. Disable close button while status IN_PROGRESS.

2. Create src/pages/github/GithubIntegrationPage.tsx: page with GitHub connection status card (icon, title, Unlink button if connected, Connect button if not). On Connect click: call getOAuthUrl, open window.open(authorizationUrl, 'GitHub OAuth', 'width=600,height=700'), listen for window message event with type 'github-oauth-success' or 'github-oauth-error'. On success, call checkConnection to fetch repos. Repo grid uses display: grid, grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(300px, 1fr)), gap: 1rem. Each repo card shows name, description, language, stars, Import button that opens RepositoryImportModal.

3. Create src/pages/github/GithubCallbackPage.tsx: reads ?code and ?state from URL query params using useSearchParams. Calls githubService.handleOAuthCallback(code, state) in useEffect. Shows LoadingOverlay while processing. On success: posts window.opener.postMessage({type: 'github-oauth-success'}, '*'), displays CheckCircle with 'GitHub Connected!', closes window after 1s with window.close(). On error: posts {type: 'github-oauth-error', error: message}, displays XCircle with error, shows Close Window button. This page is public (no auth required).
4. Update src/types/auth.ts User interface: add optional githubConnected?: boolean field. This flag will be set by backend (or checked via separate API call) to show badge in navbar.

5. Update src/components/Navbar.tsx NAV_LINKS: add GitHub link to CANDIDATE and RECRUITER arrays (not ADMIN). Link has to: '/github', label: 'GitHub', icon: . Render icon before label. If user.githubConnected is true, show small checkmark badge after label: ✓.

6. Update src/App.tsx: import GithubIntegrationPage and GithubCallbackPage. Add public route before ProtectedRoute: <Route path="/github/callback" element={<GithubCallbackPage />} />. Inside MainLayout, add protected route for CANDIDATE and RECRUITER: <Route element={<RoleRoute allowedRoles={['CANDIDATE', 'RECRUITER']} />}><Route path="/github" element={<GithubIntegrationPage />} /></Route>.

7. Add responsive CSS to GithubIntegrationPage: repo grid already responsive with auto-fill minmax(300px, 1fr). Modal width: use window.innerWidth < 768 ? '95%' : '90%' in inline style. Test at 480px, 768px, 1024px breakpoints.

findings: GitHub Integration UI successfully implemented with all required features. Created RepositoryImportModal with project selector dropdown, real-time progress polling every 2s, and proper status handling (PENDING/CLONING/INDEXING/COMPLETED/FAILED). Modal uses fixed overlay (z-index 999) and card (z-index 1000), disables close button during import, cleans up interval on unmount. Created GithubIntegrationPage with connection status card, OAuth popup window.open with postMessage listener, responsive repo grid (auto-fill minmax(300px, 1fr)). Each repo card displays name, description, language, stars count (using Star icon from lucide-react), and Import button. Created GithubCallbackPage that reads code/state from query params, calls handleOAuthCallback, posts message to parent window, shows LoadingOverlay during processing, displays success with CheckCircle or error with XCircle, auto-closes after 1s on success. Updated User interface with optional githubConnected field. Updated Navbar with GitHub links for CANDIDATE and RECRUITER roles (not ADMIN), using Code icon from lucide-react (Github icon not available in lucide-react 1.48.0), displays checkmark badge when githubConnected is true. Updated App.tsx with public route /github/callback and protected route /github for CANDIDATE and RECRUITER roles using RoleRoute. Updated ImportRepositoryRequest type to match backend API (owner, repo, projectId fields instead of repositoryId, repositoryName, cloneUrl, defaultBranch). Updated ImportStatusResponse type to match backend response (progressPercentage, currentStep, totalFiles, relevantFiles, processedFiles, totalChunks, embeddedChunks, error, startTime, endTime fields). Created projectService.ts with listProjects method (assumes /v1/projects endpoint exists in backend). Modal width adapts to screen size (95% on mobile <768px, 90% on desktop). Build completes without TypeScript errors. Lint shows only pre-existing warnings in AuthContext and AdminUsersPage, plus expected warnings for useEffect patterns in new components (common React pattern, not errors).
